text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — our 3pm backend panel today needs a backfill. Priya just pinged that she's on emergency leave. Can someone cover the oncall slot?
Maria Gonzales: I can take the triage portion at 3pm, but won't be able to stay for full debrief (need 4:30pm meeting). happy to cover the technical deep-dive.
Jon Park: I can jump in for the debrief if Maria covers the live interview. I'm on-call rotation but free from 3:45 onward.
Sam (recruiter): @Alex Kim thanks — candidate's Zoom + calendar already set. Quick details: 45m loop (15m system design, 20m coding, 10m debrief). Candidate is remote PST.
Alex Kim: Perfect. Maria covers interview, Jon covers debrief. @people-ops-bot can you update the panel list and send the access link to Jon? Also reminder: debrief notes go into the hiring folder and scores in Lever within 24h.
people-ops-bot: Scheduled: Maria Gonzales (interviewer), Jon Park (debrief). Calendar updated and invites resent.
Sam (recruiter): Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9999999999?pwd=abc123 — password is "redwood23". Please don't share outside panel.
Maria Gonzales: Thanks. Quick Q on scoring: are we still using the new lightweight rubric for backend ICs (3-point scale per axis) or the old detailed one? I want to ensure consistency.
Alex Kim: Use the lightweight rubric for now. High-level axes: System design, Problem-solving (coding), Communication/collab. Each 1-3. Add a short sentence for risks/strengths.
Jon Park: For debrief order — can we capture answers to: impact (1-3), correctness (1-3), code style (1-3), comments on on-call aptitude (pass/fail/observed concern)? This helps with tie-breakers.
Alex Kim: Yes — include "on-call aptitude" as a checkbox in the debrief doc (Observed concern / Pass / Strong). Keep comments concise.
Maria Gonzales: Noted. Will ping if candidate hits an interruption; otherwise I'll record basic snippets in the doc.
Sam (recruiter): Candidate timezone note: candidate said they might have a short interruption window ~3:20-3:25 (family call). If that happens, we can pause and resume. Flagging so interviewers don't mark poor communication for that.
Alex Kim: Good call — please annotate that in the debrief if the pause happens.
Jon Park: One more ops ask — the debrief doc link? I couldn't find it in the calendar invite.
Sam (recruiter): Debrief doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/hiring/backend-ic-debriefs/2026-03-18-candidate-23. I'll paste a template below for quick copy:
```
Candidate: [name]
Date: [yyyy-mm-dd]
Panel: [names]
Scores: System design (1-3), Problem-solving (1-3), Communication (1-3)
On-call aptitude: [Pass / Observed concern / Strong]
Risks: one-liner
Recommendation: [hire / hold / no-hire]
```
Alex Kim: Great — templates FTW. Small ops: if you're scoring a 1 on any axis, please add a sentence explaining why (helps sync with hiring manager).
Maria Gonzales: Will do. Also quick accessibility note — candidate asked for captions. Zoom captions are enabled on my client; can someone else enable host captioning in case I get bumped?
Jon Park: I can enable live transcription as host if needed.
Sam (recruiter): I'm on the invite as host — I'll enable captions at start and monitor.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Panel debrief must be submitted within 24 hours. Lever form link attached in calendar.
Alex Kim: Thanks everyone. If anything changes (Priya able to join last-minute) we'll update here. Otherwise — Maria/Jon, appreciate the cover. :thumbsup:
